surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites
evidence: The role played by the TMA molecule in the initial ALD pulse was here exploited in order to passivate the oxide/substrate interface, as broadly investigated in ALD of Al2O3 on GaAs and InxGa1–x As substrates. In this respect XPS analyses revealed, in the latter case, a slightly more pronounced oxidation of the substrate that is associated to the different chemistry of the ALD recipes.
